title: Princesses & Princes
description: The official lineup — kingdoms, love interests, sidekicks.

questions.prompt: What is Ariel's love interest's name in The Little Mermaid?
questions.explanation: Eric is the human prince Ariel saves from a shipwreck in The Little Mermaid (1989), the film that kicked off the Disney Renaissance.

questions.prompt: What kingdom is Frozen set in?
questions.explanation: Arendelle is a fictional Nordic kingdom inspired by Norway — the directors visited Norwegian fjords and stave churches for reference.

questions.prompt: What is Mulan's horse's name?
questions.explanation: Khan is Mulan's loyal black stallion, named after the Mongol leaders — fitting since the film's villains are the Huns.

questions.prompt: Which princess has a pet seagull named Scuttle?
questions.explanation: Scuttle is the seagull who hilariously misidentifies human objects — calling a fork a 'dinglehopper' used for combing hair.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Cinderella's mouse friend who wears a red shirt and yellow hat?
questions.explanation: Jaq is the slim, leader-type mouse in Cinderella (1950); his round, chubby pal is Gus, whom Jaq rescued from a trap.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Jasmine's pet tiger?
questions.explanation: Rajah is Jasmine's fiercely protective Bengal tiger in Aladdin (1992); 'rajah' means king or monarch in Hindi.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Rapunzel's chameleon sidekick?
questions.explanation: Pascal is the silent, expressive chameleon in Tangled (2010) who changes colour with his mood and slaps Flynn awake with his tail.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Moana's pet pig?
questions.explanation: Pua is Moana's adorable potbellied pig — he gets left behind on Motunui, so the dim rooster Heihei tags along instead.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Moana's rooster companion?
questions.explanation: Heihei is the famously dim-witted rooster voiced by Alan Tudyk, who has voiced an animal in nearly every Disney film since Frozen.

questions.prompt: Who is Belle's love interest in Beauty and the Beast?
questions.explanation: The Beast's human name 'Prince Adam' was never spoken in the 1991 film; it came from supplementary materials and merchandise.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Mulan's tiny dragon guardian?
questions.explanation: Mushu is voiced by Eddie Murphy in Mulan (1998); he was demoted from family guardian and is trying to win his job back.

questions.prompt: Who is Tiana's love interest in The Princess and the Frog?
questions.explanation: Naveen is the spoiled prince of fictional Maldonia who's turned into a frog by Dr. Facilier in the 2009 New Orleans-set film.

questions.prompt: What is Pocahontas's raccoon friend called?
questions.explanation: Meeko is the mischievous, food-obsessed raccoon in Pocahontas (1995); his name comes from an Algonquin word for a small animal.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Pocahontas's hummingbird friend?
questions.explanation: Flit is the protective ruby-throated hummingbird who distrusts John Smith and constantly tries to keep Pocahontas out of trouble.

questions.prompt: Who is the love interest in Tangled?
questions.explanation: Flynn is the charming thief's alias; his real name is Eugene Fitzherbert, and he's voiced by Zachary Levi in Tangled (2010).

questions.prompt: What is the name of Merida's horse in Brave?
questions.explanation: Angus is Merida's enormous black Shire horse in Brave (2012), Pixar's first film with a female lead.

questions.prompt: How many brothers does Merida have in Brave?
questions.explanation: Her identical red-headed triplet brothers — Harris, Hubert, and Hamish — get turned into bear cubs after eating an enchanted tart.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Raya's loyal armadillo-dragon-like steed?
questions.explanation: Tuk Tuk starts as a tiny pill-bug-sized pet and grows into a giant rolling mount in Raya and the Last Dragon (2021).

questions.prompt: What is the name of the last dragon in Raya and the Last Dragon?
questions.explanation: Sisu is voiced by Awkwafina; her name comes from a Finnish word meaning stoic determination and inner strength.

questions.prompt: Who is Aurora's prince in Sleeping Beauty?
questions.explanation: Phillip is the first Disney prince given a real personality and screen time; he slays the dragon-form Maleficent in Sleeping Beauty (1959).

questions.prompt: What is the name of Ariel's fish best friend?
questions.explanation: Despite his name, Flounder is actually a tropical yellow-and-blue fish — not a flounder, which is a flat bottom-dwelling species.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Ariel's crab advisor?
questions.explanation: Sebastian is the Jamaican-accented court composer who sings 'Under the Sea' — the song won the 1989 Oscar for Best Original Song.

questions.prompt: What is Elsa and Anna's snowman called?
questions.explanation: Olaf is voiced by Josh Gad and was built by the sisters as children; he dreams of experiencing summer despite being made of snow.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Anna's love interest in Frozen?
questions.explanation: Kristoff is the gruff ice harvester raised by trolls, voiced by Jonathan Groff; his best friend is the reindeer Sven.

questions.prompt: What island does Moana set sail from?
questions.explanation: Motunui is the fictional Polynesian island where Moana is the chief's daughter in Moana (2016); 'motu nui' means 'big island'.
